criteria.name: Clarity and intelligibility
criteria.description: For the team's answer to the Moderator's question: whether the presentation is clear and systematic, answers the question, and gives a coherent argument clearly and succinctly.

criteria.name: Identification and discussion of central ethical dimensions
criteria.description: For the team's answer to the Moderator's question: whether the presentation clearly identifies and thoroughly discusses the central ethical dimensions of the case.

criteria.name: Deliberative thoughtfulness
criteria.description: For the team's answer to the Moderator's question: whether the presentation shows awareness and thoughtful consideration of different viewpoints, especially those important to people who disagree with the team.

criteria.name: Opposing-team commentary
criteria.description: Overall score for the team's commentary on the opposing team's presentation, considering the three official evaluation criteria.

criteria.name: Response to opposing-team commentary
criteria.description: Overall score for the team's response to the opposing team's commentary, considering the three official evaluation criteria.

criteria.name: Response to judges' questions
criteria.description: Overall score for the presenting team's response to judges' questions, considering the three official evaluation criteria.

not_observable_from_deck: optional Spirit Points, which do not count toward the official 60-point total

records.limitations: Scores a produced match transcript/speech packet; live opponent interaction and judge questioning are benchmark adaptations.
